context.body: A sequence of petitions, judgments, replacements, and executions establishes the kingdom.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Adonijah is executed after requesting Abishag, Abiathar is removed, Joab is killed, Benaiah is elevated, and Shimei dies after breaking an oath.
observations.label: Solomon consolidates the throne: action

observations.body: Bathsheba, priests, soldiers, and rivals are drawn into the consolidation.
observations.label: Solomon consolidates the throne: response

observations.body: ask Abishag · put to death · altar · kingdom established
observations.label: Words in 1 Kings 2:13–46

payload.posture: Read 1 Kings 2:13–46 as promise and succession evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The narrator reports fulfilled words and political security while leaving readers to examine the means.
payload.title: Solomon consolidates the throne
